title: School Life Paragraph
titleMy: ကျောင်းသားဘဝအကြောင်း စာပိုဒ်
description: A paragraph about school where every sentence starts with a capital letter; practice the shift timing between sentences.

exercises.instruction: Type the passage and land each capital letter on the beat of the full stop.
exercises.text: Our school has many big and bright classrooms. The teachers are kind and patient. We study English, Math, and Science every day. I enjoy learning new things with my classmates.
